vcsl.licence_quote: This collection is under a Creative Commons 0 license. Essentially it's Public Domain- you can do whatever you want with these sounds (even make commercial software), no royalties, no credit, no special terms.

vsco2-ce.maker: Versilian Studios LLC (Sam Gossner) and Simon Dalzell
vsco2-ce.licence_quote: The library is under a Creative Commons 0 (i.e. public domain) license. That's right, you can download 3 GB of samples for free with no rules, no royalties, no limits on how or when you can use it
vsco2-ce.licence_note: The repository's LICENSE (2016-07-08) is the CC0 1.0 legal code. Its Readme.txt (2016) asks, under 'Terms', that the samples not be sold directly and that Versilian Studios be credited; under CC0 these are requests, not conditions, and the publisher's page above (read 2026-10-22) says 'no rules'.
